assertion.statement: For the actual final primitive form f and H=ker(epsilon), the rational diamond quotient Jacobian J_H has A_f as a Q-isogeny factor. Over the same Lprime it has the actual non-CM surface A as an isogeny factor, so A times Z is Lprime-isogenous to J_H and dim J_H≥2.
assertion.objects: The actual form f, its newform quotient A_f of J_1(N), the rational curve X_H=X_1(N)/H, J_H, the effective diamond group and the existing D210 A/Lprime.
assertion.hypotheses: The rational Gamma_H model, newform-quotient differential description, actual realization of r_ell in A_f and Tate restriction for A are supplied. A is absolutely simple. Faltings Hom comparison, rational scalar extension and Poincare reducibility are retained.
assertion.quantifiers: The same final primitive form after twisting, including every Galois conjugate of its differential; the same Lprime used for actual Tate restriction.
assertion.parameter_range: Arbitrary weight-two nebentypus and coefficient degree; H contains−1.
assertion.uniformity: No coefficient-field degree or extra cyclotomic extension is introduced.
assertion.constants: g=dim J_H≥2. The quotient identities use |H_eff|, not a duplicated central−1 factor.
assertion.normalizations: q e_H=q follows from all conjugate differentials. Use pi-star pi-push=sum over effective H, and pi-push pi-star=[|H_eff|]; averages over H and H_eff agree. The source Jacobian has its canonical principal polarization.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No bounded polarization degree for A or Z is assumed. No use of an ineffective H sum as the quotient degree. The actual representation inclusion and Faltings theorem remain separate inputs.
assertion.limit_order: Construct rational quotient; descend the newform quotient through the effective projector; obtain the constituent in J_H; compare actual Tate modules over Lprime; apply Hom and reducibility.
